name: Zechariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Isaiah took faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah, then went to the prophetess, who conceived and bare a son.

note.label: Isaiah 8: Maher-shalal-hash-baz, the Snare, and the Law and the Testimony
